findings.issue: "Round 5 – Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot 2026 | Group Stage | Combined" lists its channel as "DAZN" (visible at all three widths). Every other channel on the board is a Norwegian option (TV 2, TV 2 Play, Viaplay, HBO Max (Sport), NRK); DAZN does not match any of those and stands out as a likely foreign/non-Norwegian broadcaster. Worth a human check of whether DAZN is a genuine Norwegian viewing option for this event.

notes: Match names fully readable at all three widths, no truncation that hides key info; both sides of every fixture (Norge – Wales, Danmark – Norge, Salamanca UDS – Celta Vigo, the Copa del Rey pairings) are legible.

Channel column otherwise honest and Norwegian: '–' shown for genuinely unknown channels (Bybit Stockholm Open, FAGE WTA Finals Indian Wells, lower-tier Copa del Rey matches), Norwegian options elsewhere (TV 2 / TV 2 Play, Viaplay, HBO Max (Sport) +1, NRK) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky seen.

National flags render correctly (🇳🇴 on Austin Championship, DP World Tour Championship, Norge–Wales, Danmark–Norge, Lillehammer; a proper Celta Vigo shield crest) — no broken-image icons or empty boxes.
No horizontal scroll or clipped content at 375, 393, or 900px; header, day-group headings ('I DAG', 'I MORGEN', weekday headers), 'Neste opp', and footer all intact and aligned.
Single quiet column maintained at all widths; must-see accent dots used sparingly (not on every row).

Floating 'Assistent' button overlaps the mid-agenda 'Salamanca UDS – Celta Vigo' row at 375/393px (covering only the '–' separator between the two team names, both names stay fully readable) and sits over the 'Norge – Wales' row at 900px — matches DESIGN.md's sanctioned floating-button idiom (WP-146 variant D); it does not occlude the last agenda row or the footer, so not flagged as an issue.

Footer 'AI-budsjett: uke 52% · økt ?%' shows a literal '?' for the session figure — checked docs/data/usage-state.json, which has session: null, and docs/js/chrome.js intentionally falls back to '?' for a missing value (same honest-placeholder pattern as the '–' channel dash); working as designed, not a rendering bug.
